An AI assistant for sales helps automate and scale routine sales tasks, from outreach and follow-ups to scripting and prioritization, so your team can focus on closing deals. Is Milli a generative AI for sales? Yes - but not only that. Milli uses generative AI to draft emails, scripts, and proposals, while also acting as an AI sales agent that helps organize outreach, guide next steps, and keep your sales workflow moving. It combines generation with execution, not just content creation. Why choose an AI agent for sales? Because sales isn’t just about ideas - it’s about execution. An AI sales agent takes care of the repetitive, time-sensitive work like outreach preparation, follow-ups, and prioritization, so your team can focus on real conversations and closing deals without added overhead. What's the difference between AI sales agent and assistant? An AI sales assistant responds when asked - it helps draft emails, suggest copy, or answer questions. An AI sales agent works proactively, organizing workflows, preparing outreach in advance, and recommending next steps. Milli combines both, assisting on demand while also acting as an agent that keeps your sales process moving without constant oversight. How to practice sales with Milli? You can practice sales with your AI sales agent by running mock scenarios. Milli can simulate sales conversations, role-play objections, and help you rehearse pitches, follow-ups, and negotiation responses. This lets you test messaging, refine your approach, and build confidence before engaging real prospects. Sintra is more than just Milli Milli is part of the Sintra AI ecosystem.
